chunks: And ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله entered al-Madīnah, he marked out its houses with his foot, then said: “O Allah, whoever sells a plot of land from it, do not bless him in it.”

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; opening of a supplication
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةَ: al-Madīnah, the city entered by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about selling land in al-Madīnah?
ai.summary: This hadith relates an action and supplication of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم upon entering al-Madīnah. It indicates the special sanctity and value of the land of al-Madīnah and conveys disapproval of selling part of its land through the Prophet’s supplication.
